track_width_m.name: track_width_m
track_width_m.provenance: Ford Fiesta Mk7 OEM rear track width specification
track_width_m.rationale: Required for differential wheel yaw rate calculation during gyro dropout. Not explicitly in IO-VNBD CSV headers.

zero_speed_threshold_ms.name: zero_speed_threshold_ms
zero_speed_threshold_ms.provenance: Empirical stationary sensor noise floor threshold
zero_speed_threshold_ms.rationale: Velocity below ~0.28 km/h indicates stopped vehicle; activates Zero-Velocity Update (ZUPT) to prevent stationary drift.

accel_weight_baseline_b.name: accel_weight_baseline_b
accel_weight_baseline_b.rationale: Weight on integrated longitudinal acceleration vs wheel speed in Baseline B during normal driving.

slip_diff_threshold_ms.name: slip_diff_threshold_ms
slip_diff_threshold_ms.rationale: Discrepancy threshold between left/right wheel speeds to trigger tire slip mitigation mode.

max_plausible_speed_ms.name: max_plausible_speed_ms
max_plausible_speed_ms.provenance: Physical passenger vehicle kinematic upper bound (~250 km/h)
max_plausible_speed_ms.rationale: Used in causal quality gate to reject corrupted or out-of-range sensor spikes.

BASELINE_A.name: Differential Wheel Odometry + CAN Yaw Rate
BASELINE_A.equations: v_fwd = (v_RL + v_RR) / 2; psi_k = psi_{k-1} + omega_z * dt; dE = v_fwd * sin(psi_mid) * dt; dN = v_fwd * cos(psi_mid) * dt

BASELINE_B.name: Kinematic Wheel Odometry + CAN Yaw Rate + Longitudinal Acceleration Fusion
BASELINE_B.equations: v_filt = (1-w) * v_wheel + w * (v_filt + a_x * dt); psi_k = psi_{k-1} + omega_z * dt; planar ENU integration
BASELINE_B.purpose: Slip-resilient kinematic dead-reckoning baseline with acceleration complementary fusion

BASELINE_C.name: CAN Inertial-Only Planar Integration Baseline
BASELINE_C.equations: v_fwd = v_{k-1} + a_x * dt; psi_k = psi_{k-1} + omega_z * dt; planar ENU integration
BASELINE_C.purpose: Diagnostic baseline demonstrating rapid unbounded quadratic drift without wheel odometry feedback
